title: CineMR: Tool-Integrated Vision-Language Reasoning for Quantitative Cardiac MRI Assessment
abstract: arXiv:2610.01166v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Cardiovascular magnetic resonance (CMR), including cine imaging, is a reference standard for the noninvasive assessment of cardiac morphology and ventricular function. Cine CMR interpretation integrates qualitative visual assessment with quantitative measurements of ventricular volumes, ejection fraction, myocardial mass, wall thickness, and regional wall motion. Current medical vision-language models (VLMs) cannot reliably derive quantitative measurements from multidimensional cine images without analysis tools. We present CineMR, a tool-augmented VLM that invokes cardiac image-analysis tools and integrates their outputs into interleaved reasoning for quantitative CMR assessment. translated_title: CineMR：面向定量心脏磁共振评估的工具集成视觉-语言推理
translated_abstract: 心血管磁共振（CMR），包括电影成像，是无创评估心脏形态与心室功能的参考标准。电影CMR的判读需要将定性视觉评估与心室容积、射血分数、心肌质量、室壁厚度以及局部室壁运动的定量测量相结合。当前的医学视觉-语言模型（VLM）在缺乏分析工具的情况下，无法从多维电影图像中可靠地获取定量测量结果。我们提出了CineMR，这是一种工具增强的VLM，它能够调用心脏图像分析工具，并将其输出整合到交错的推理过程中，以实现定量的CMR评估。我们还构建了一个多队列视觉问答基准，涵盖定量指标提取、多类别诊断和鉴别诊断任务，并配备了分割、相位选择、容积测量、形态测量以及局部室壁运动分析等工具。
tldr: 该论文提出了CineMR，一种工具增强的视觉-语言模型，通过调用心脏图像分析工具并将输出整合到交错推理中实现定量心脏磁共振评估，并构建了涵盖定量指标提取、多类别诊断与鉴别诊断的多队列视觉问答基准。
en_tdlr: The paper presents CineMR, a tool-augmented vision-language model that invokes cardiac image-analysis tools and integrates their outputs into interleaved reasoning for quantitative cardiac MRI assessment, together with a multi-cohort visual question answering benchmark covering quantitative metric extraction, multiclass diagnosis, and differential diagnosis.
